releases.name: Winlator 11.2
releases.body:
**v11.2 (Latest)**

- Added an option to save memory on run games from Steam
- Improved the presentation of rendered images
- Implemented XInput extension for raw input
- Implemented an option to run Winlator as foreground service (by @Juan-Antonio-Doe)
- Updated Mesa Turnip (v26.2.0 from @whitebelyash branch)

**v11.2 (Beta)**
- Fixed gamepad input lag
- Added Box64 v0.4.4 (release)
- Improved Vortek:
	└─ Improved texture decoding (it was not handling mipmaps correctly)
	└─ Some improvements were added for the Xclipse GPU

	└─ Improved the OpenGL 1.X emulation (Half-Life is now rendering correctly)

	└─ Added fixes for shader compilation on the Xclipse GPU

- Improved Vortek (fixed exposed extensions and disabled some extensions for Mali devices)

- Fixed some bugs on Vortek

- Added support for controller vibration
- Added Light/Dark app themes

- Improved Steam compatibility
- Improved Vortek
- Added new desktop wallpapers

releases.name: Winlator 10.1 (Hotfix)
releases.body:
**v10.1 (Hotfix)**

- Added fixes for Steam Client startup
- Added AdrenoTools to Vortek
- Removed dgVoodoo from DX Wrappers
- Other bug fixes and improvements

**v10.1 (Initial Release)**

- Implemented MIDI Input/Output
- Added support for external MIDI controllers
- Added new control types in Input Controls
- Added option Move Mouse when pressing button (Input Controls)

releases.name: Winlator 10.0 (Hotfix)
releases.body:
**v10.0 (Hotfix)**

- Added fallback URL for Wine Mono/Gecko installation
- Added fixes for Vortek
- Updated/Recompiled internal programs: wfm.exe, winhandler.exe, TestD3D.exe and GPUInfo.exe

**v10.0 (Final)**

General changelogs:

- Improved Task Manager
- Added GPUInfo to Start Menu (Useful for viewing GPU capabilities)

Vortek changelogs:

Notes: The Root FS has been restructured and each library has been compiled individually, keeping only those required by Box64/Wine

releases.name: v26.0.0 - Revision 8 + super beta 8xx support
releases.body:
### **UPDATE 2**: Added working a8xx Turnip. **Please read the notes below.**  - Thanks whbexium
### **UPDATE**: Fixed an issue with the drivers not loading properly.

## Based on latest mesa main source v26.0.0-devel.

## v26.0.0 R8
Vulkan 1.4.335
Base commit:  e9a83d530cce

### NOTES

## The a8xx support included is **very** beta and hacky. **Use at your own risk!**  
An example of what might happen (which happened to me) using this with Mincraft Pojav-glow-worm on a840, it will crash and the default driver won't recover causing every apps to crash afterwards. (a reboot fixed it) 

What works very well: OpenGL games through x86_64 emulators.
What does not work: Switch emulators and non OpenGL games (so far tested. They boot but render very buggy graphics).

---

- This still uses Old autotuner. If you need new Autotuner, [use v25.3.0 here](https://github.com/K11MCH1/AdrenoToolsDrivers/releases/edit/v26.0.0-rc.03).

- a710 and 720 can use regular or Gmem. When using regular driver on Winlator, do uncheck sysmem and check gmem from the TU_DEBUG list in the Environment Variables. For other emulators, use Gmem driver.
- For users with the ONE UI bug, use the following environmental variable: `FD_DEV_FEATURES = enable_tp_ubwc_flag_hint=1`

---

### CHANGELOG

- Merged upstream.
- General optimizations and bug fixes.

---

### APPLIED PATCHES

**Turnip_v26.0.0_R8_Gmem.zip**
- Added a710/720 GPU descriptors (hacks)

**Turnip_v26.0.0_R8_Autotuner.zip**
- Autotuner Overhaul

**a8xx_0x5_handle.zip**
- Added a830v2 GPU descriptor (hack)
- Added 0x5 handle (hack)
Thanks Hardware Union RU/ENG boys

---

### Thanks to ❤️
Rob Clark
Karmjit Mahil
Connor Abbott
StevenMX
Pablo
Mark
Weabchan

Vita3K Android Release 12
releases.body:
Vita3K Android release 12 Changelog (non exhaustive list):
- SD card support: Allow any folder to be specified as the OS/game data folder (inspired by the PR from nurunuruslime)
- Allow the overlay to be used at the same time as the touchscreen
- Fix black bands appearing sometimes at the top and bottom of the application on some devices
- Fix bug causing game installation to be 10x slower than expected
- Fix accelerometer and gyroscope on android game consoles
- Some crash fixes
- Add controller opacity (dima)



Rebase on PC version:
- Fix audio regression (bookmist)
- Code cleanup, refractoring and small optimisations (bookmist, Nishinji and GermanAizek)
- Improved error messages (croden)
- GUI improvements (Zangetsu)
- Improve depth-stencil retrieval, fix Ratchet and Clank (Macdu)
- Add support for module unloading/reloading, allows FFX to be playable (Macdu)
- Improve ffmpeg dependency (KhoraLee)
- Improve Transfer downscale/copy, fix graphical issues in Phantasy Star Nova (Macdu)
- Improve Polish localization (mavethee)

releases.name: Vita3K Android Release 11
releases.body:
Vita3K Android release 11 Changelog (non exhaustive list):
- Revert part of the shader optimisations from the last release (because of turnip driver bugs...)
- Fix some issues with the handling of MSAA 2x, fix graphical issues (partial blur) in some Nihon Falcon games
- Allow custom drivers and renderer to be set differently for each game
- Fix some crashes when installing games / custom drivers
- Use a static version of ffmpeg now that the Android version is open source

Rebase on PC version:
- Implement fractional upscaling, allows game to render at 1.25x, 1.5x (or 0.5x) the original resolution (Macdu)
- Add a FPS hack option which allows some games running at 30 FPS on the PS Vita to run at 60 fps on the emulator (Ys 8, GoW, Uncharted...) (Macdu)
- Language updates (Corden, nishinji)
- Multiple fixes (bookmist)
- Use hardware accelerated decryption: speed up game installation by almost 10x (Macdu)
- Improve depth/stencil identification: Fix shadows in Gravity Rush (Macdu)
- Use paths instead of wide strings for paths (bookmist)
- Improve path support on Linux (Steveice10)
- Put audio parameters in a new audio tab (Zangetsu)
- Add PS vita Audio/video folder access and crash fixes (bookmist)
- Fix sRGB PNG texture exportation (dima)

releases.name: Vita3K Android Release 10
releases.body:
Android v10 Changelog (non exhaustive list):

- Fix crash on Android 14 (thanks to Kazuki/Adrien for their help)
- Graphical fixes for double buffer (fix the rendering in Terraria)
- Fix some io-related Android specific crashes
- Implement asynchronous shader compilation: reduces significantly stutter caused by shader compilation (at the cost of temporary graphical glitches) and speed up by 2x-3x shader compilation time
- Shader performance improvements
- Fix some performance regressions from v9

PC rebase:

- Use guest pointer for the gxm alloc space, allows FIFA to go ingame with native buffer / page table (Macdu)
- gxm and renderer refractoring (bookmist)
- Improce codec/renderer YUV support, fixes the FMV in Ys origin (Macdu)
- Plenty of shader fixes: Fix graphical issues in 2D ubisoft games (child of light, Rayman) (Macdu)
- Fix kernel thread end callback, allows Tearaway to go ingame (Macdu)
- Page align the stack top, allows spiderman to go ingame (Macdu)
- Decrease the rendertarget size, allows Killzone to go ingame (Macdu)
- Update Indonesia/Malaysia translation (Croden, kitakata, darkhash)
- Update Japanese translation (nishinji)
- Plenty of other shader fixes: Fix GPU crash in Spiderman and Exist archive (Macdu)
- Rewrite TransferCopy: performance improvements and fix graphics in Spiderman (Macdu)
- Fix a gxm softlock, allow Unit 13 to go ingame (Macdu)
- Happy new year! (ExtremeExploit)

releases.name: Vita3K Android Release 9
releases.body:
Android v9 Changelog (non exhaustive list):

- Improvements to double buffer: Fix graphics in games like J-Star victory, Gravity Rush...
- Overlay joystick improvements: You can now run diagonally
- Touchscreen fixes: Fix regressions and touchscreen issues
- Overlay improvements: Should use a lot less GPU power
- Overlay: The overlay button size can now be modified
- App pausing: Re-enabled and no longer freezes the application
- Fix gxm alignment issues: Fix regressions in Tokyo Xanadu, Trails of Cold Steel 2
- Texture replacement support: Support png, uncompressed textures, BCn compressed textures (Snapdragon only), ASTC compressed textures (any phone). Textures have to be manually places in /Android/data/org.vita3k.emulator/files/textures/import/game_id


PC Rebase:
- Kitakata/Zangetsu: Add Indonesian and Malaysian languages
- ExtremeExploit: Use curl for http request, should fix issues preventing the compatibility database to be updated
- redpolline: Refractor the filesystem architecture (not relevant for Android but still a lot of work)
- Macdu: Improvements and fixes to the ngs player, fix the Audio in Borderlands 2, Mickey Power of 2, Valhalla Knights 3
- Macdu: Fix ingame dialogs freezing the emulator under certain circumstances
- Macdu: Plenty of shader fixes, fixes the graphics of Hyperdimension Neptunia, FIFA and Borderlands 2 (require shader cleanup)
- Macdu: Improve ngs support of mono voices, fixes AoT game audio
- Macdu: Properly initialize gxm texture objects, fixes cutscenes in GoW
- Macdu: Rewrite the surface and texture cache, performance improvements and needed for texture replacement
- Macdu: Vulkan refractor, fixes chaos ring and improve performance for driver with bad memory allocators

releases.name: Vita3K Android Release 8
releases.body:
Android V8 Changelog:

- Implement motion sensor: If you have a connected controller which has motion sensors, these will be used. Otherwise your device motion sensors will be used
- Add renderer accuracy option
- Add an option to create a shortcut for each game. The shortcut will be added to your home screen and use the game name and icons.
- Make sure clang does not optimize function calls it thinks are useless (fixes fmv flickering)
- Improve memory trapping (fixes freezes when using double buffer)
- Memory mapping can now be configured for each game (and can be modified before starting a game without rebooting)
- Rewrite the texture cache architecture, should fix games becoming slower over time
- Update to NDK 26
- Update SDL to 2.28.3 (improve controller support)
- Multiple performance improvements (using faster data structures and less mutex locking)

PC rebase (non exhaustive list):

- Zangetsu: Add support for controller touchpad (PS4/PS5 controller), not tested on Android
- Croden, HuanJiCanShang: Translation improvements
- Scribam: Code cleanup and update dependencies
- Macdu: Implement litteral buffers, thread buffers and texture buffers, used by World of Final Fantasy and Gundam Breaker 3
- Good afternoon, Dima: Implement controller rebinding
- Macdu: Implement shader store, Fixes most 3D unity games and J-Star
- Nishinji: Add an option to stretch the screen ingame to occupy all the space available (but does not respect the aspect ratio)
- Bookmist: Kernel fixes and some crash fixes


 About renderer accuracy, the versions v1-v7 were using what is now the "high" accuracy. By default the accuracy is set to standard, compared to high it decreases the amount of memory used and improves performance. This can cause some small graphical glitches in some games because this is not entirely accurate (although I haven't seen any graphical glitches yet), so its is recommended to use this setting for Android.

releases.name: NetherSX2 v2.2n Net Dev Build
releases.body:
Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays and a Happy New Year everyone!

This update adds experimental Online Multiplayer to NetherSX2 along with the usual updates!
Thanks to [IamLupo](https://github.com/IamLupo) for adding it to ARMSX2, and [zakilj3](https://www.youtube.com/user/zakilj3) for discovering the same settings work with NetherSX2!

[VirusTotal Scan Report](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/2029e30dcc1ba1ecb8d73313f18b429b40e6044c7785c52af08b948ef94b3ddf)

## How to use Online Multiplayer
1. Go to your App Settings --> Settings and toggle on Enable DEV9 Ethernet
2. Set API to Sockets, and Device to how you want to connect online with the default being WiFi. Set this to VPN if your phone uses a VPN, and to one of the two SIM DATA options if you want to use your Mobile Data Plan instead
3. That should be enough to get you online using a guide like [this](https://youtu.be/dcOnZzzcbSc?si=WOf01r0Ln5ZVQkpf&t=278) by LogicalMacrochip

You can use the [Official List of PlayStation 2 Online Games (2024)](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15pfhL36qmC-iKr8MNjNXNLwgacG4VOmkfvwVxV5vGzo/edit?gid=0#gid=0) to figure out what games work, get their DNAS bypass codes if needed and which private server you should be using

For more advanced options (or you want to use the second method from the guide by LogicalMacrochip), you can do the following:
1. Set DNS1 Mode to Manual
2. Under DNS1 select either [PS2 Online](https://ps2online.com) (called Cristian in the Official list) or [PSRewired](https://psrewired.com)
Note: This can also be changed on a Per Game Settings and more servers will be added soon
To turn it off just set DNS1 Mode to Auto and DNS1 to 0.0.0.0

[zakilj3](https://www.youtube.com/user/zakilj3) created a more [comprehensive guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uZzEXvNXUUU) to make it easier for people

releases.name: NetherSX2 v2.1
releases.body:
This release should correct any [performance loss](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HivQHfB5rtw) and [visual regressions](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cViX9lEP2mw) found with the NetherSX2 2.0 release while coming with a nice performance boost and several bug fixes on top of that

A huge thank you to [Retro Handheld Guides](https://www.youtube.com/@RetroHandheldGuides), [Alexwpi Game](https://www.youtube.com/@AlexwpiGame), reddit and the bug testers for pointing out these issues

### Update Notice
I've updated the APK to fix the following bugs:
* Several visual glitches in GTA: SA
* Broken FMVs in MGS3: Subsistence
* The odd blue filter applied over MGS3: Subsistence

[Virus Total Report](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/a39fe9f88de54d35a39152ce4c003ec15c9dd82064cad57b0455ac1a5cd61050)

## Changelog:
### Patched
* All Jak games now receive OI_JakGames which fixes some visual issues
* Brought back partialTargetInvalidation in 4248 to see if the 310 extra instances of it helps fix games
* recommendedBlendingLevel has been removed from 4248 to be more inline with 3668 (most people ignore the message anyway)
  - It only displayed a warning. We have minimumBlendingLevel and maximumBlendingLevel for setting the Blending Level automatically
* Added estimateTextureRegion to the Tales games to see if it helps with their performance issues
* Rebuilt the PartialTargetInvalidation configuration file with the better InstantDMAHack fixes implemented

### General
* Bumped version to v2.1
* Hardcore RetroAchievements support has been fixed - it was temporarily broken with the v2.0.6 test build
* Setting inheritance doesn't transfer over autoFlush and cpuSpriteRenderBW since they break more than they fix
  - This fixes the fog wall in Wrath of Cortex and the black eye textures in the Jak games
* Restored the FullVU0SyncHack setting since it DOES exist in both versions
  - Should fix the performance loss with the games that use it
* Fixed the issue where the Cover Downloader didn't download the link provided by the user
* Removed InstantDMAHack from inheritance and we prefer DMABusyHack over it. This should fix the MGS games
*  Implemented common fixes into the conversion script, which fixes:
   - The Atelier Iris games' FMVs
   - The Godfather's broken fullscreen colour filter
   - Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas' performance 
   - The Jak games' shadow issues using Vulkan
   - Metal Gear Solid 3: Subsistence's performance drop when camouflaged
   - The Digital Devil Saga games issue with texture alignment and lights shining through walls
   - The Lord of the Rings: Two Towers' FMVs
   - Timesplitters' light shining through walls
* Implemented an inheritance exclusion feature that can exclude games from being changed. This avoids over-tuning games (like Driv3r) that has had a lot of settings changes over the years
* Added a fix for Hitman Blood Money
* The Conversion script now output files with more descriptive names
* Implemented the ability to insert multiple hardware fixes using the game's serial
* Implemented the ability to insert multiple game fixes using the game's serial
* Better Resolution Scaling list values to help pick the best resolution for your device without sacrificing performance
* Updated widescreen and no-interlacing patches to latest provided by [Saramagrean](https://github.com/Saramagrean/NetherSX2-cheats)
* Updated the Controller DB to latest from [SDL_GameControllerDB](https://github.com/mdqinc/SDL_GameControllerDB)

## Known Issues
* Google Play Protect may give you a warning when installing the APK due to us using test keys to sign the application
* **SAVE STATES ARE NOT COMPATIBLE BETWEEN 3668 AND 4248!** Please use memcard/in-game saves if you plan to jump between Patch and Classic
* NASCAR and Colin McRae Rally games have graphical issues with 4248 - use [3668](https://github.com/Trixarian/NetherSX2-classic/releases) if you plan to play them
* Older Mali devices may have rendering issues and/or crashes on Vulkan with certain games (like Dark Cloud 2). Generally this just requires the use of OpenGL to get past the problematic parts of the game before switching back to Vulkan. The latest Mali chipsets do not have this issue. Using [3668](https://github.com/Trixarian/NetherSX2-classic/releases) is also a viable solution for these games
* CHD files made with createdvd will not work with the emulator unless you use the flag ```-c zlib```. Since createcd chd files are generally smaller, it may be preferable to use them when space is a concern
* Newer texture packs (made in or after 2024) will not work. This is due to PCSX2 changing how dumped textures are named. PCSX2 will also automatically rename the files to the new naming scheme when older packs are used with it - breaking their compatibility with NetherSX2 in the process. Hopefully the ability to dump textures with NetherSX2 will help mitigate this issue
* Newer RetroAchievements that uses the Remember and Recall functions within RA - so achievement sets made in the last year and half may not work with NetherSX2

## Special Thanks
* A Huge Thank You to Miguel, WZi, McThor, [protokoul](https://github.com/protokoul), [PrinceP14](https://github.com/PrinceP14) and two private sponsors for their support on my [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/reallynottrix) and [Github Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/Trixarian) pages! Your combined generosity makes it possible for me to work on this and many other projects!
* [MrSujano](https://www.youtube.com/@MrSujano), [Retro Game Corps](https://www.youtube.com/@RetroGameCorps), [Joey's Retro Handhelds](https://www.youtube.com/@JoeysRetroHandhelds), [TechDweed](https://www.youtube.com/techdweeb), [Retro Ryan](https://www.youtube.com/@RyanRetro), [Adin Walls](https://www.youtube.com/@adinwalls), [Alexwpi Game](https://www.youtube.com/@AlexwpiGame), [Retro Handheld Guides](https://www.youtube.com/@RetroHandheldGuides) and many other YouTube channels for spreading awareness of and creating guides for NetherSX2

## Test Devices & Huge Thanks to
* [AYANEO](https://www.ayaneo.com) for providing me with the powerhouse known as the [AYANEO Pocket S2 Pro](https://www.ayaneo.com/product/AYANEO-Pocket-S2)
* [Retroid](https://www.goretroid.com) for providing me with a [RP Mini](https://www.goretroid.com/collections/retro-game-system/products/retroid-pocket-mini-v2-handheld) and [RP5](https://www.goretroid.com/collections/retro-game-system/products/retroid-pocket-5-handheld)

releases.name: NetherSX2 v2.0
releases.body:
First full release of the year and it comes with an APK! 
NetherSX2 1.9a, NetherSX2-Classic 2.0a and the new [NetherSX2-Classic 2.0](https://github.com/Trixarian/NetherSX2-classic/releases/tag/2.0) releases can be updated with this file

[Virus Total Report](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/916c2c07d389471d60714a2ef569bc00c832abadb6579de6d03edf756755f8da)

## Changelog:
### NetherSX2 Changes
* First APK build for 4248!
* Bumped version to 2.0
* Added Texture Dumping - thanks [Saramagrean](https://github.com/Saramagrean)!
* Updated the Widescreen & No-Interlacing patches - thanks again [Saramagrean](https://github.com/Saramagrean/NetherSX2-cheats)!
* Updated the Russian translation - thanks b1ack_mage!
* Covers now appear larger in the Game List Grid View - thanks b1ack_mage
* New On-Screen Controls:
![Screenshot_2025-06-15-01-12-18-769_xyz aethersx2 android](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1bd4f8fc-92bf-41bf-a7c6-4ef07bb63cb1)
Credits:
AetherSX2/Duckstation basis by Stenzek
Better L2 and R2 buttons by k6stor
Colored face buttons by b1ack_mage 
Reworked for better consistency by me

### GameDB Changes
* Updated the GameDB via the upgraded conversion script (see below)

The conversion script has been overhauled and now produces GameDB files that has the original settings dynamically mixed with the latest fixes provided by PCSX2, with an option to override any of them for better Android or core compatibility. This gives us the stability provided by the original settings with the added benefits that come with the newer ones - which include better performance for several games

### Controller DB Changes
* Updated to the latest ControllerDB from [SDL_GameControllerDB](https://github.com/mdqinc/SDL_GameControllerDB)

## Known Issues
* Google Play Protect may give you a warning when installing the APK due to us using test keys to sign the application
* **SAVE STATES ARE NOT COMPATIBLE BETWEEN 3668 AND 4248!** Please use memcard/ingame saves if you plan to jump between them
* NASCAR and Colin McRae Rally games have graphical issues with 4248 - use [3668](https://github.com/Trixarian/NetherSX2-classic/releases) if you plan to play them
* Older Mali devices may have rendering issues and/or crashes on Vulkan with certain games (like Dark Cloud 2). Generally this just requires the use of OpenGL to get past the problematic parts of the game before switching back to Vulkan. The latest Mali chipsets do not have this issue. Using [3668](https://github.com/Trixarian/NetherSX2-classic/releases) is also a viable solution for these games
* CHD files made with createdvd will not work with the emulator unless you use the flag ```-c zlib```. Since createcd chd files are generally smaller, it may be preferable to use them when space is a concern
* Newer texture packs (made in or after 2024) will not work. This is due to PCSX2 changing how dumped textures are named. PCSX2 will also automatically rename the files to the new naming scheme when older packs are used with it - breaking their compatibility with NetherSX2 in the process. Hopefully the ability to dump textures with NetherSX2 will help mitigate this issue
* Newer RetroAchievements that uses the Remember and Recall functions within RA (generally achievement sets made in the last year and half) will not work with NetherSX2. Some efforts are being made to fix this

## Special Thanks
* A Huge Thank You to Miguel, WZi, McThor and [protokoul](https://github.com/protokoul) for their support on my [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/reallynottrix) and [Github Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/Trixarian) pages! Your combined generosity helped me more than any of you'll ever know and makes it possible for me to work on NetherSX2 and EtherealSX2!
* [EZOnTheEyes](https://www.youtube.com/@EZOnTheEyes) and the [Ozone Modification Group](https://discord.gg/xRh3NnYyMa) Community for giving us a home, and providing support and bug testing for NetherSX2
* [MrSujano](https://www.youtube.com/@MrSujano), [Retro Game Corps](https://www.youtube.com/@RetroGameCorps), [Joey's Retro Handhelds](https://www.youtube.com/@JoeysRetroHandhelds), [TechDweed](https://www.youtube.com/techdweeb), [Retro Ryan](https://www.youtube.com/@RyanRetro), [Adin Walls](https://www.youtube.com/@adinwalls) (a fellow South African) and countless other YouTube channels for spreading awareness and creating guides for NetherSX2
* [Retroid](https://www.goretroid.com/) for providing an unknown developer like me with a [RP Mini](https://www.goretroid.com/collections/retro-game-system/products/retroid-pocket-mini-v2-handheld) and [RP5](https://www.goretroid.com/collections/retro-game-system/products/retroid-pocket-5-handheld) that gave me the ability to test NetherSX2 and EtherealSX2 with Snapdragon devices when no other company was interested. You guys actively helped make both emulators better!

--- > [!NOTE] > This release invalidates any existing generated shader cache. > Because of this, performance may temporarily be impared after updating from 2126.2 or earlier. > Performance will improve again after playing for a while. --- # Azahar 2127.0-rc3 Changelog # All - Added a new "Limit frames ahead of GPU" setting to toggle a previously introduced optimization which improves latency, now disabled by default. | @DavidRGriswold #2793 - Since 2127.0-alpha4, this behaviour was always enabled, but some users reported that it caused a performance regression. - Users with a sufficiently powerful device can now choose to enable it manually to reduce input latency in exchange for performance. # Android - Fixed a bug where all setting values in Azahar's `config.ini` file would be written directly, rather than leaving untouched values blank. | @DavidRGriswold #2784 - Due to this issue, Azahar setups which have run on Azahar 2127.0-rc1 or 2127.0-rc2 will no longer properly reflect any future changes to Azahar's default settings. - This can be resolved by resetting all settings in Azahar's settings menu after upgrading to a version with this fix. - Fixed an issue where devices running Android 17 or later would be unable to connect to a real 3DS device or other local devices. | @OpenSauce04 #2803 - Azahar will request a new Local Network Access/ Nearby Devices permission on these devices when run for the first time after updating. # Desktop - Fixed multiple issues relating to default hotkey values. | @DavidRGriswold #2791 - Fixed some issues relating to keyboard navigation in the game list. | @DavidRGriswold #2783

releases.name: Azahar 2127.0 Release Candidate 1
releases.body:
⚠️Important Release Candidate Information⚠️

This is a release candidate. Please expand this drop-down to read more about what this means before installing.
As a release candidate, this build is not yet considered a stable release, but is instead a build which could be promoted to a stable release if it is sufficiently tested with no major issues being discovered. Ideally, the release candidate period will last for 7 days, however if major issues are discovered, this will be extended to allow for additional testing with a corrected release candidate.

Despite its status as a pre-release build, users are encouraged to test this version to help us catch any newly introduced issues before the build is promoted to a full release. If you do observe such issues, please report them to us on GitHub so we can evaluate them.

If you are unwilling to tolerate potential minor issues, you may be better off waiting until a release candidate is promoted to a full release.

Users are advised to back up their Azahar user data directory before using a pre-release build.
--- # Summary Azahar 2127.0 is arguably the single largest update we have ever published, and is a truly monumental release. It includes countless improvements, fixes and new features, including long-awaited additions such as per-game setting support on Android, a fully rewritten interpreter for JIT-less environments which allows full-speed emulation on any modern iOS device, support for a new bundled ROM format which includes game content and updates in a single file, a fix for a long-standing death animation glitch in Shin Megami Tensei IV, and many, many other things. We hope you'll take a quick read of the changelog to see what we've been working on. --- > [!NOTE] > This release invalidates any existing generated shader cache. > Because of this, performance may temporarily be impared after updating from 2126.2 or earlier. > Performance will improve again after playing for a while. --- # Azahar 2127.0-rc1 Changelog # License - **Azahar's license has been changed** from GPLv2+ to **GPLv3+**. All downstream projects exposed to Azahar's source code must ensure that they follow the license terms and correctly update any license metadata as necessary. | @OpenSauce04 #2626 #2635 # Android - Added per-application settings. | @DavidRGriswold, @Producdevity #1856, #2698 - Mimics the desktop behaviour of being able to configure emulated applications independently. - Can be accessed by long pressing the application from the application list. - Implemented the use of the ADPF API to hint the OS of CPU work bursts. | @PabloMK7 #2706 - Improves performance on most Android devices, with a 15% performance boost observed on a Mali device. - Skip hidden dot files/folders when scanning for applications. | @wilu222 #2362 - Turbo speed is now disabled when a game is started, matching the behaviour on desktop platforms. | @ygordreyer #2657 - Closing a game which was opened from an Android home screen shortcut now closes Azahar. | @ygordreyer #2658 - Fixed an issue where, when relaunching a currently running game from an Android home screen shortcut, Azahar would display a black screen. | @ygordreyer #2656 - Fixed an issue which could cause Azahar to crash when connected to a secondary display under certain circumstances. | @DavidRGriswold #2751 - Relaxed custom graphics driver checks to allow usage of custom drivers on non-Adreno devices. | @PabloMK7 #2767 # All - Implemented a significantly faster new interpreter for JIT-less environments, named `FastInterp`, which replaces the old `DynCom` interpreter. | @warmenhoven #2376 - This new interpreter allows greatly improved performance on iOS and tvOS devices, allowing devices as old as the iPhone XS to use the emulator, even with playback speeds of over 200%. - Added support for a new ROM format: ROM Bundles (`.bcxi`, `.bcci`, `.bcia`). | @PabloMK7 #2369, #2673 - ROM Bundles can store a base game and any necessary additional files, such as the game's updates, DLC, or any necessary system files (e.g. Mii data) within a single file. This makes it easier to manage and organize your game library, while also allowing for easier of use of game updates, DLC, and system files in libretro frontends (e.g. RetroArch) via `.bcxi`/`.bcci` files. - `.bcxi`/`.bcci` bundles allow content which would previously have to be installed via a CIA file, such as game updates and DLC, to be used alongside the base game without installing anything to the emulated 3DS. - `.bcia` files contain the content of multiple CIA files, allowing their collective content to be stored and installed via a single file. - ROM Bundles can be created using `Tools -> Create ROM Bundle...` on desktop platforms. - Creating ROM Bundles on Android is currently not possible, but bundles created on a desktop device can be run on any platform as long as Azahar's version is at least 2127.0 or later. - For more information, please read the PR description: #2369 - Added an experimental new MSAA anti-aliasing setting. | @Wunkolo #2053 - This setting is currently not exposed in the UI, and must be enabled manually by editing Azahar's ini config file. - This functionality will become more easily accessible in a future update following additional stability improvements. - Fixed inaccurate color blending behaviour in the Vulkan renderer, fixing an issue in Shin Megami Tensei IV where a black box would appear around enemies when killed. | @quickstraw #2427 - Corrected misuses of linear filtering in the video core where nearest neighbour should be used. | @OpenSauce04 #2554 - Fixes texture rendering issues in Minecraft: New Nintendo 3DS Edition, and likely other games as well. - Reduced several audio, frame and input latency sources on all platforms. | @PabloMK7 #2700, #2706 - Improves audio, frame and input latency by 1-2 frames in some cases. - Makes audio time stretching disabled by default. - Adds a setting to disable audio effects for the cubeb backend (Windows only). - The pull requests descriptions go into more detail on what exactly changed. - Added free camera support. | @PabloMK7 #2723 - Uses the RPC server to submit free camera commands to the emulator from an external script. - A python script is provided in the `dist` folder that contains a global free camera implementation, controllable using a controller. - Due to the way the 3DS GPU works, per-application implementations are still the preferred way to do free camera. - Added configurable battery state. | @Wunkolo #2513, @PabloMK7 #2743, @DavidRGriswold #2738 - Allows setting the emulated system battery to a fixed percentage and charging state, or use the host system battery state. - Makes the emulated notification LED blink red when the battery is critical. - Added a turbo (hold) hotkey. | @DavidRGriswold #1969 - Not to be confused with the existing turbo hotkey, which is a toggle. - Fixed save states not working with LLE modules enabled. | @PabloMK7 #2730 - Added a visual warning that prompts users to reset the vulkan shader cache if the emulator crashes during cache loading. | @PabloMK7 #2709 - Improved "disable right eye" setting heuristics. | @Davey-Hughes #2467 - Fixes visual glitches in many applications with the setting enabled. - Fixed files opened with append mode starting on the wrong position. | @PabloMK7 #2707 - Fixes OpenGL shader cache not working properly on Android vanilla and MacOS builds. - Fixed `BOSS::GetNsDataHeaderInfo` behaviour. | @PabloMK7 #2740 - Fixes StreetPass Mii Plaza SpotPass puzzles being marked as invalid. - Fixed ADD PC instruction handling in thumb mode. | @PabloMK7 #2710 - Fixes crashes when using the CPU interpreter with LLE modules enabled. - Fixed CPU core1 scheduler time limit value check. | @PabloMK7 #2711 - Fixes 3DS Sound failing to start from the home menu. - Fixed `APT::GetWirelessRebootInfo` behaviour to match real hardware. | @PabloMK7 #2712 - Fixes Star Fox 64 3D (Taiwan) failing to start. - Hardened stride aliasing validation on surface validation. | @Angelico2102 #2451 - Fixes visual glitches in Inazuma Eleven GO Galaxy. - Fix DSP sleep behaviour to better match real hardware timings. | @PabloMK7 #2731 - Fixes fatal errors on some applications (most notably New Super Mario Bros. 2) when launched from the home menu. - Fixed async upload of custom textures. | @nal532 #2688 - Fixes custom texture related crashes and issues. - Fixed incorrect use of host timings on fs operations with deterministic mode. | @PabloMK7 #2732 - Fixes a source of movie replay desync. - Implemented a previously missing audio delay/echo effect in the HLE DSP implementation. | @PabloMK7 #2473 - Restores previously missing echo effects to many games, such as New Super Mario Bros. 2, when using HLE audio. - Fixes a stuttering music issue in Shinobi 3D. - Implemented improvements for Azahar's texture codec, resulting in greatly improved texture handling performance and general performance improvements in many games. | @PabloMK7 #2564 - Zero-area render passes are now skipped. | @Wunkolo #2510 #2544 - This addresses certain graphical issues in 3D Thunder Blade. - Implemented null descriptors for null surfaces. | @Wunkolo #2545 - Minecraft: New Nintendo 3DS Edition now force-disables the "Disable Right Eye Rendering" setting while running due to causing rapidly flashing rendering issues. | @OpenSauce04 #2555 - Due to ongoing issues, the Anime4K texture filter has been limited to only be selectable when using the OpenGL renderer. | @OpenSauce04 #2654 - Implemented emulation for the CSND module, allowing applets (e.g. the 3DS keyboard), 3GX plugins, and certain early homebrew applications to play audio. | @PabloMK7 #2680 - Fixed an issue which could cause CIA content in a ROM Bundle to not be installed correctly if it was compressed into a `.zcia` file before being bundled. | @DevYukine #2679 - When attempting to bind a button or hotkey to an already bound input, a dialog which asks whether you want to unbind the previously bound button or hotkey is displayed instead of just showing a failure message. | @DavidRGriswold #1838 - Fixed several minor inaccuracies in the HLE GSP module, potentially fixing unknown edge cases in certain games. | @PabloMK7 #2678 - Implemented additional optimizations for Azahar's JIT shader compiler. | @Wunkolo #2597 - Check table_dirty before skipping proctex LUT upload. | @Dandandans #2627 - Implemented signature checks for downloaded encrypted content (e.g. eShop downloads, system files). | @PabloMK7 #2753 - Fixed an issue in the video core which could cause performance slowdowns on weaker devices when running non-60fps games. | @PabloMK7 #2755 - Fixed an issue where, when any 3D display mode was enabled, touch inputs in the right half of the screen would not be recognized. | @DavidRGriswold #2766 - Fixed a packet data handling issue which could cause issues in some multiplayer games. | @PabloMK7 #2770 # Windows - In line with our previous deprecation, the MSYS2 build of Azahar has now been removed, with the MXE build replacing it. | @OpenSauce04 #2582 - Implemented a custom scrollbar style in Azahar's Qt frontend with improved visibility. | @OpenSauce04 #2642 # Desktop - Azahar now contains its own copy of FFmpeg, meaning that downloading and installing FFmpeg manually before using the Dump Video feature is no longer necessary. | @OpenSauce04 #2584 - Added optional on-screen software keyboard during emulation. | @rpnesseling #2185 - Improves text input on handheld devices that are controller/touchscreen focused. - This option is disabled by default. - Fixed an issue which could cause Azahar to hang indefinitely on startup if certain controllers were connected before opening. | @PabloMK7 #2769 - Fixed certain issues related to Azahar's video dumping functionality. | @PabloMK7 #2771 - Fixed an issue which prevented the context menu from appearing after right-clicking under certain monitor configurations. | @PabloMK7 #2768 - Improved motion emulation functionality when using a mouse. | @SpinCodeIt #2422 - Fixed hat inputs not correctly detecting release and press state. | @DavidRGriswold #2457 - Fixed path handling by converting paths to UTF-8 before using them with the raw C++ `fs` interface. | @PabloMK7 #2713 - Fixes crashes with paths that contain non-ASCII characters. - Improved keyboard navigation for game list. | @DavidRGriswold #1985 - Fixed an issue where Azahar's .ini files could contain non-human-readable values. | @Wunkolo #2534 - Added new hotkeys "Configure" and "Configure Current Application". | @crueter #2218 # libretro - Fixed an issue with touchscreen devices where, when pressing a blank area outside of the touchscreen area, the last selected location on the touchscreen would become activated. | @OpenSauce04 #2563 # Technical - Added additional logging when an attempted pixel format reinterpretation is unimplemented. | @Wunkolo #2508 - Added new CMake options to newly allow compiling with certain system libraries. | @kreinholz #1987 - Added new CMake option `ENABLE_CCACHE`. | @crueter #2219 - Added a missing include which allows Azahar to be compiled for Android with NDK r30. | @rtiangha #2622 - Fixed an issue which prevented building Azahar with openal-soft version 1.25.2 and newer. | @rtiangha #2617 - releases.name: Winlator Ludashi 5.0
releases.body:
What's new:

## 🖥️ X++

\- Added **X++**, a native X server in C++ with asynchronous presentation for Android
\- X++ is now the default. The Java backend remains available as **X11**.
\- Reduced repeated scene work and improved Support for OpenGL, offscreen windows, XInput, and ARGB cursor handling.

## 🎮 Steam Integration

\- Added Steam support, downloads, library, online, Cloud saves.
\- Added friends, chat and achievement features
\- Improved offline setup, play your steam games offline without steam client
\- steam can be disabled in store settings.

## 💻 DisplayX

\- Rewrote Backend, updated transport, buffer completion and presentation scheduling.
\- Added SDR/HDR Support for compatible games/devices.

## 🎞️ Frame Generation

\- Added **LSFG**, adapted from Eden, and optional **WFG** (Winlator Frame Gen).
\- Added engine selection, quality and multiplier controls, adaptive pacing and refresh-rate limits.
\- WFG supports Vulkan 1.1 and direct output where supported, with a fallback path.
\- LSFG may need Turnip driver on renderer selection on A6xx devices.
\- Frame generation requires the Vulkan renderer. Compatibility and performance depend on the GPU, driver and game.

## 📈 In-Game Sidebar

\- Fixed Modern HUD enabling itself after restarting a game.
\- Fixed the first in-game HUD activation opening Classic instead of Modern.
\- Fixed HUD toggle checkmarks and persistence of effects after they were disabled in-game.
\- Preserved Classic and Modern options and improved live size, opacity and reset behavior.
\- Improved spacing, renderer status and RTL layouts.

## 💾 Library

\- Added per-game preset copying, import and export, with a share icon in shortcut settings.
\- Added game-save backups and shortcut/global save-management controls.
\- Made automatic artwork downloads optional.
\- Improved container navigation, keyboard layout and screen-orientation persistence
\- Added Brazilian Portuguese translations and refined sidebar and control labels.
\- Added a Compose controls editor and interactions adapted from Ludashi Plus and WinnLite.

## 📦 Components

\- Updated bundled **Turnip to 27.0.0**, **Box64 to 0.4.5** and **FEXCore to 2611**.
\- Updated Arm64ec Proton packages and made Proton 11 the default,use Proton 9 if you have issues
\- Added Freedreno driver imports.
\- Improved offline installation, backups, rollback and component removal.
\- Added an ARM64 SSBS option,this can improve performance on Oryon chips, labeled **Enable SSBS**.
\- Adreno 825 / Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 configurations default to Zink instead of Freedreno.
\- Restored the VKD3D shader-model option and improved Wine component version handling.

## 🔊 Audio/ Input

\- Added **Alsa-Oboe** as the default audio backend, with PulseAudio-Gamenative still available.
\- Improved virtual controls, touch handling and controller registration before Wine starts.
\- Improved controller wait handling and native XInput support.

## 🛠️ Stability / Diagnostics

\- Improved Vulkan swapchain recovery, imported-image layout tracking and GPU resource lifetimes in VulkanRenderer.
\- Fixed cursor upload synchronization, resize handling and presentation semaphore reuse.
\- Improved XComposite redirection, child-window rendering and offscreen window positioning.
\- Preserved the HyperOS 3 vendor-driver preload fix.
\- Added optional device info graphics diagnostics, GPU tests and benchmarks.
\- Added opt-in Vulkan validation Layer and **Enable Winlator logcat** capture.
\- Added signed Winlator-Update support

## 📝 Notes

\- The project is now distributed under **GPLv3**
\- new Discord Server https://discord.gg/JWdQqXkayG
\- this is the first release with Steam/FG Support, not everything is guaranteed to work 100% on all devices, So I expect comprehension

## Credits

\- @Pipetto-crypto — Winlator Bionic upstream improvements.
\- @brunodev85 — original Winlator.
\- @teldommm and @squalle0nhart — UI and interface improvements.
\- WFG (Winlator/Winnative Framegen) by @qwertypower
\- [Eden](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/src/branch/master/src/video_core/frame_gen) — LSFG implementation used as the basis for frame generation.
\- [WinNative](https://github.com/WinNative-Emu/WinNative) — credit for half of the Steam integration.
\- [Gamesir-gf](https://github.com/gamesir123/xserver-gf) — part of the code for X Server backend

releases.name: Ludashi 4.0: Early Access
releases.body:
What's new:


📲 UI
\- Completely rewrote the UI using Jetpack Compose.

🖥️ Renderer Backend

\- Added a new EGLRenderer.
\- Improved the overall performance of the VulkanRenderer and added ReShade support.

\- Added DisplayX, a new implementation based on SurfaceFlinger for native composition.
\- Provides support for the Android Hardware Composer (HWC).
\- Supports the Android Performance Hint API.
\- Supports an X Server bypass, allowing DisplayX to bypass the traditional X Server composition path.
\- DisplayX is currently experimental.

---

🖥️ X Server

\- Fixed a long-standing issue with X resource management.

\- Reworked the DRI3 and Pixmap extensions to provide proper direct rendering support.

\- Reworked the Drawable backend to allow hardware-accelerated Xlib buffers.

\- Added the GLX extension for Zink DRI3, allowing proper GPU-accelerated OpenGL rendering.

\- Added the XComposite extension for proper offscreen rendering support.

\- Improved Zink performance for OpenGL games, benefiting non-Adreno GPUs.

\- Added support for Freedreno, the Powerful OpenGL driver for Adreno GPUs.

\- Freedreno can massively improve performance in OpenGL games.

📦 Proton & Assets

\- Updated all Proton assets.

\- Added support for:
 \- RandR
 \- XInput2
 \- XComposite

\- Added new Proton 9, Proton 10, and Proton 11 versions, Proton 10 and 11 are compatible with Fex Unixlibs

\- Playing OpenGL games using Proton 11 is currently not recommended.

🎮 On-Screen Controllers

\- Added support for custom icons and fixed bugs.

🖱️ Input

\- Fixed issues with relative mouse input.

🔊 Audio

\- Added GameNative PulseAudio.

📈 Modern HUD

\- Added GPU name detection and display.

\- Added several additional improvements and adjustments to the Modern HUD.

📝 Notes

As always, delete your old Ludashi build or change the package name. This version does not install as an update.

Bug fixes and improvements are planned for future updates.

Regarding Frame Generation and Steam support: no, they are not planned. However, I will release all the source code so other projects can use my features if they want.

releases.name: GameHub Lite v5.1.8
releases.body:
## Security: Steam token redaction in logs

GameHub Lite 5.1.8 fixes a logging issue where Steam authentication-related values could appear in diagnostic logs. 
In some cases, logs could include fields such as `steamToken`, `refreshToken`, or `accessToken` from Steam login/launch flows.

**Publicly posted logs containing these fields should be deleted or redacted.**

### IMPORTANT

This should go without saying but If you find any security issues, please reach out **PRIVATELY**. 
I have not checked if this issue is still present in recent GameHub versions, already ruined my one day off I was spending with my family by the person who reported this publicly and I do not plan on spending any more time on this.

### Changelog

The fix adds centralized log redaction for Steam/auth token fields, Steam QR login URLs, JWT-like token strings, and launch command token arguments before logs are written. This covers the app loggers, JavaSteam logging, and the PC launch-log file writer.

This release also pins local patch builds to `apktool 2.12.1`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite/compare/v5.1.7...v5.1.8

releases.name: GameHub Lite v5.1.6
releases.body:
# GameHub Lite v5.1.6

This release fixes an actual app-side launch issue, and yes, also exists because apparently backend fixes do not count unless there is a fresh APK attached to a GitHub release.

The main app fix is for devices where GameHub would silently refuse to launch games when the `getUnknownDevices` / `startType` API path returned a `404`. Instead of failing closed and doing absolutely nothing, the app now falls back like it already did for the no-internet path.

Confirmed affected and fixed:

- AYANEO Pocket FIT
- Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 / Adreno 750
- Android 14

### Backend changes

More work happened in [gamehub-lite-api](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api), because that is where a lot of compatibility and component delivery work lives now.

Backend changes since the `v5.1.5` release include:

- Updated simulator response timestamps so stale responses get refreshed.
- Added release asset verification and MD5 checks for GitHub release assets.
- Updated component manifests, timestamps, deprecated component removal, and total counts.
- Cleaned up SteamAgent2 manifest naming.
- Removed drivers that were already added in the latest GameHub manifest.
- Added asset name deduplication and repair for release assets.
- Updated release asset procedures and documentation.

Relevant API commits:

- [834e17d](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api/commit/834e17d3d6fad50fbf203a7ea3a7601c02b7852e) - add release asset verification and MD5 check for GitHub releases
- [222a697](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api/commit/222a6971215589ec95dcfde1155b5389925f849d) - update component manifests and remove deprecated components
- [33397e7](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api/commit/33397e7f3a3f8f838af35fe522ba13f786219f3f) - update SteamAgent2 file name in manifest
- [7fb4a9f](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api/commit/7fb4a9fa23ddf81f67903230217760396cc8eb76) - remove drivers already added in the latest GameHub manifest
- [6945b39](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api/commit/6945b392654f9d771a6d5502a4f6477da3cc1afd) - asset name deduplication and repair for release assets
- [c8cbf04](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api/commit/c8cbf04aafc794b80d77d28e5bae1bcaaddd0b08) - update release asset procedures and checks
- [fb58ff9](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api/commit/fb58ff942f4ea6602a641898faa5c288f4d2ff99) - refresh stale response timestamps

### App changes

- Fixed silent game launch failure when the backend returns `404` for `getUnknownDevices` / `startType`.
- Bumped app version to `5.1.6`.

## What's Changed

* fix: allow launch when getUnknownDevices/startType API returns 404 by @The412Banner in https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite/pull/131


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite/compare/v5.1.5...v5.1.6

1. Go to your App Settings --> Settings and toggle on Enable DEV9 Ethernet
2. Set API to Sockets, and Device to how you want to connect online with the default being WiFi. Set this to VPN if your phone uses a VPN, and to one of the two SIM DATA options if you want to use your Mobile Data Plan instead
3. That should be enough to get you online using a guide like [this](https://youtu.be/dcOnZzzcbSc?si=WOf01r0Ln5ZVQkpf&t=278) by LogicalMacrochip

You can use the [Official List of PlayStation 2 Online Games (2024)](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15pfhL36qmC-iKr8MNjNXNLwgacG4VOmkfvwVxV5vGzo/edit?gid=0#gid=0) to figure out what games work, get their DNAS bypass codes if needed and which private server you should be using

For more advanced options (or you want to use the second method from the guide by LogicalMacrochip), you can do the following:
1. Set DNS1 Mode to Manual
2. Under DNS1 select either  [PS2 Online](https://ps2online.com) (called Cristian in the Official list) or [PSRewired](https://psrewired.com)
Note: This can also be changed on a Per Game Settings and more servers will be added soon
To turn it off just set DNS1 Mode to Auto and DNS1 to 0.0.0.0

[zakilj3](https://www.youtube.com/user/zakilj3) created a more [comprehensive guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uZzEXvNXUUU) to make it easier for people

releases.name: NetherSX2 Classic v2.1
releases.body:
This release should correct any [performance loss](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HivQHfB5rtw) and [visual regressions](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cViX9lEP2mw) found with the NetherSX2 2.0 release while coming with a nice performance boost and several bug fixes on top of that

A huge thank you to [Retro Handheld Guides](https://www.youtube.com/@RetroHandheldGuides), [Alexwpi Game](https://www.youtube.com/@AlexwpiGame), reddit and the bug testers for pointing out these issues

### Update Notice
I've updated the APK to fix the following bugs:
* Several visual glitches in GTA: SA
* Broken FMVs and blue filter issue in MGS3: Subsistence
* Slow downs caused by not properly using vu separation
* Slow downs caused by the experimental gpuTargetCLUT to cpuCLUTRender conversion

[Virus Total Report](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/5518c0f0ec7d820ff96b51cca37c2db30b8601fc4e1ccef84bd03659c8d1a643)

## Changelog:
### Classic
* Using cpuCLUTRender as a replacement for gpuTargetCLUT - this should get us a slight performance boost and better visual quality
* Added experimental support for estimateTextureRegion's features by using disablePartialInvalidation. This should have the performance benefits for Snowblind games

### General
* Bumped version to v2.1
* Hardcore RetroAchievements support has been fixed - it was temporarily broken with the v2.0.6 test build
* Setting inheritance doesn't transfer over autoFlush and cpuSpriteRenderBW since they break more than they fix
  - This fixes the fog wall in Wrath of Cortex and the black eye textures in the Jak games
* Restored the FullVU0SyncHack setting since it DOES exist in both versions
  - Should fix the performance loss with the games that use it
* Fixed the issue where the Cover Downloader didn't download the link provided by the user
* Removed InstantDMAHack from inheritance and we prefer DMABusyHack over it. This should fix the MGS games
*  Implemented common fixes into the conversion script, which fixes:
   - The Atelier Iris games' FMVs
   - The Godfather's broken fullscreen colour filter
   - Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas' performance 
   - The Jak games' shadow issues using Vulkan
   - Metal Gear Solid 3: Subsistence's performance drop when camouflaged
   - The Digital Devil Saga games issue with texture alignment and lights shining through walls
   - The Lord of the Rings: Two Towers' FMVs
   - Timesplitters' light shining through walls
* Implemented an inheritance exclusion feature that can exclude games from being changed. This avoids over-tuning games (like Driv3r) that has had a lot of settings changes over the years
* Added a fix for Hitman Blood Money
* The Conversion script now output files with more descriptive names
* Implemented the ability to insert multiple hardware fixes using the game's serial
* Implemented the ability to insert multiple game fixes using the game's serial
* Better Resolution Scaling list values to help pick the best resolution for your device without sacrificing performance
* Updated widescreen and no-interlacing patches to latest provided by [Saramagrean](https://github.com/Saramagrean/NetherSX2-cheats)
* Updated the Controller DB to latest from [SDL_GameControllerDB](https://github.com/mdqinc/SDL_GameControllerDB)

## Known Issues
* Google Play Protect may give you a warning when installing the APK due to us using test keys to sign the application
* **SAVE STATES ARE NOT COMPATIBLE BETWEEN 3668 AND 4248!** Please use memcard/in-game saves if you plan to jump between Patch and Classic
* Black, Ace Combat, the Jak games and various other games have graphical issues. Many of them have been fixed in [4248](https://github.com/Trixarian/NetherSX2-patch/releases)
* Snowblind engine games (Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance, Champions games and Justice League Heroes) has several issues with 3668. For better performance and less issues, use [4248](https://github.com/Trixarian/NetherSX2-patch/releases)
* CHD files made with createdvd will not work with the emulator unless you use the flag ```-c zlib```. Since createcd chd files are generally smaller, it may be preferable to use them when space is a concern
* Newer texture packs (made in or after 2024) will not work. This is due to PCSX2 changing how dumped textures are named. PCSX2 will also automatically rename the files to the new naming scheme when older packs are used with it - breaking their compatibility with NetherSX2 in the process. Hopefully the ability to dump textures with NetherSX2 will help mitigate this issue
* Newer RetroAchievements that uses the Remember and Recall functions within RA - so achievement sets made in the last year and half may not work with NetherSX2

## Special Thanks
* A Huge Thank You to Miguel, WZi, McThor, [protokoul](https://github.com/protokoul), [PrinceP14](https://github.com/PrinceP14) and two private sponsors for their support on my [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/reallynottrix) and [Github Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/Trixarian) pages! Your combined generosity makes it possible for me to work on this and many other projects!
* [MrSujano](https://www.youtube.com/@MrSujano), [Retro Game Corps](https://www.youtube.com/@RetroGameCorps), [Joey's Retro Handhelds](https://www.youtube.com/@JoeysRetroHandhelds), [TechDweed](https://www.youtube.com/techdweeb), [Retro Ryan](https://www.youtube.com/@RyanRetro), [Adin Walls](https://www.youtube.com/@adinwalls), [Alexwpi Game](https://www.youtube.com/@AlexwpiGame), [Retro Handheld Guides](https://www.youtube.com/@RetroHandheldGuides) and many other YouTube channels for spreading awareness of and creating guides for NetherSX2

## Test Devices & Huge Thanks to
* [AYANEO](https://www.ayaneo.com) for providing me with the powerhouse known as the [AYANEO Pocket S2 Pro](https://www.ayaneo.com/product/AYANEO-Pocket-S2)
* [Retroid](https://www.goretroid.com) for providing me with a [RP Mini](https://www.goretroid.com/collections/retro-game-system/products/retroid-pocket-mini-v2-handheld) and [RP5](https://www.goretroid.com/collections/retro-game-system/products/retroid-pocket-5-handheld)

releases.name: Winlator 7.1.3 with Native Glibc
releases.body:
## What's New
#### Added
- Added **MIDI** support, allowing some games to play MIDI audio. The software comes with an open-source soundfont by [default](https://musical-artifacts.com/artifacts/1517), and you can also install your preferred soundfont in the `Settings` (currently, only SF2 format is supported). Download Windows MIDI Soundfont [here](https://musical-artifacts.com/artifacts/713).
- Improved **OpenXR** suooport. Many thanks to **Luboš V.** , his work making OpenXR support possible and better.
- Improved Game Controller Support, you can now selectively use **XInput** or **DInput** mapping. Linear triggers now work with both mapping modes. For trigger button, if it’s not working correctly, try adjusting the trigger button mode in the `Settings` to match your controller.
- Added the feature to automatically set the container's **Locale**. You can now also adjust `LC_ALL` settings in the container editing interface.
- Added Landscape And **Portrait Mode** switching features. You can now switch to portrait mode using the container's resolution settings or `Toggle Orientation` button of the left-side navigation bar.
- Added the ability to reconfigure containers. You can now click `Reconfigure` in the container options to reconfigure the Wine prefix on the next startup.
  
#### Fixed
- Fixed the stuttering issue when exiting the container.
- Fixed the issue where shortcuts on the desktop remained available after deleting the container.
- Fixed the issue with binding gamepad analog sticks in InputControlEditor.
- Fixed the issue that shortcuts sometimes lost their settings.
- Fixed the issue where clicking on the screen and input controls simultaneously in touch screen simulation mode caused crashes.
- Fixed the missing End key issue in InputControlEditor.
- Fixed the issue when creating a new container would reset the version and preset of box64.
- Fixed the issue where groups in the box64 rc file could not be disabled.
- Fixed the issue where the mouse pointer was inaccurate when using simulated touch screen in full-screen mode.
- Fixed the issue where the file provider did not support moving files.
- Fixed the issue where reinstalling the file system sometimes skipped the opt folder.
- Fixed the issue where external storage could not be added as a Wine drive.
  
#### Changed
- Update Wine to 9.16.
- File provider enabled by default.
- Added gst-libav.
  
####  What's new about OpenXR Support?
- Fixed the issue causing crashes at startup.
- Fixed 3DoF support to ensure it functions correctly, rather than running in 2DoF mode.
- Fixed some graphical glitches on the Meta Quest 3.
- Added controller mapping functionality in the settings.
- Fixed the black screen issue on QuestOS V69.
  
#### FAQ
1. #### What is Winlator with Native Glibc?
   Many thanks to **BrunoSX** for developing [Winlator](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator), a practical and popular PC simulation software. Winlator Glibc is not an upgrade but a mod to Winlator. It uses Glibc patches from Termux-pacman to build the necessary packages, achieving the same goals as the Proot-based solution but without the I/O performance loss associated with Proot. However, due to the exclusion of Arm32 and limitations in Wine's support for wow64, its compatibility with 32-bit applications is not as good as the vanilla Winlator.
1. #### Where to Get Latest Turnip Driver?
   Thanks to **K11MCH1** and **JeezDisReez**, the latest Mesa Turnip drivers are available for Winlator and can be found [K11MCH1/WinlatorTurnipDrivers](https://github.com/K11MCH1/WinlatorTurnipDrivers).
3. #### Why not Include the New Box64 and Drivers in App?
   Box64 and the Turnip Driver are updated frequently, so installing them externally ensures they are always up to date. Therefore, the app only includes their latest release versions.
4. #### Reinstall or Overwrite?
   You do not need to uninstall the old Winlator Glibc before installation. However, if you have installed a different version, you must uninstall it before installing the new one due to different signatures. Please make sure to **BACK UP** your data.
5. #### Game has Sound but Blank.
   Try using box64 version 0.3.0 or earlier and try using wine-9.2.
4. #### What is .wcp?
   **.wcp** is the file extension for add-ons. It is compressed using **XZ** or **Zstd** and includes a **profile.json** file as a manifest. You can create your own add-on files containing various contents. Since these files often include executable programs, **make sure** to verify that add-ons from other sources do not contain malicious software before installation.
6. #### What is .rcp?
   **.rcp** is the file extension for custom Box64 configuration files. It uses a JSON data structure and can be used to generate a box64rc file that Box64 can read. You can refer to [official box64rc](https://github.com/ptitSeb/box64/blob/main/system/box64.box64rc) to configure the rcp file, but you **cannot** import it directly.
  
**Additional Files**:
1. **box64-0.3.1-0450371.wcp**: contains `box64-0.3.1`, built from [ptitSeb/box64](https://github.com/ptitSeb/box64/commit/0450371e282bd5c4dbbceaeca590626304609036).
3. **box64-0.3.1-0450371-8g2.wcp**: contains `box64-0.3.1`, built from [ptitSeb/box64](https://github.com/ptitSeb/box64/commit/0450371e282bd5c4dbbceaeca590626304609036). Disabled BAD_SIGNAL for 8gen2 and enabled the 8G2 option, which **may** improve performance.
7. **box64-0.2.7.wcp**: contains `box64-0.2.7`, built from [ptitSeb/box64](https://github.com/ptitSeb/box64).
8. **wine-9.2-custom.wcp**: contains `wine-9.2`. Added MIDI support and improved controller support for Wine 9.2. Please avoid using the older version of Wine 9.2.

## What's Changed
* OpenXR - Fix crash on init by @lvonasek in https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator/pull/36
* midi: Add midi support. by @longjunyu2 in https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator/pull/38
* OpenXR - Fix 3DoF by @lvonasek in https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator/pull/40
* controller: Try fix controller issues. by @longjunyu2 in https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator/pull/44
* OpenXR - Reopening fixed by @lvonasek in https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator/pull/46
* OpenXR - Fix 3DoF camera by @lvonasek in https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator/pull/47
* OpenXR - Workaround for graphical glitches by @lvonasek in https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator/pull/50
* OpenXR - Controller mapping in settings by @lvonasek in https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator/pull/52
* OpenXR - Crash fix by @lvonasek in https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator/pull/53
* Fixed cannot see changes of input controls until reset. by @longjunyu2 in https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator/pull/56
* OpenXR - Fix for QuestOS V69 by @lvonasek in https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator/pull/58

## New Contributors
* @lvonasek made their first contribution in https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator/pull/36

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator/compare/v7.1.2...v7.1.3

releases.name: Winlator 7.1.2 with Native Glibc
releases.body:
#### Added
- Added support for `Box64rc`, allowing different Box64 parameters to be set for each process.
- Added `virtual touchscreen` support, also referred to as `direct cursor` support. True touchscreen support requires implementing the XInput2 extension.
- Added support for Chinese. And any corrections to the translation are welcome.
- Added an `content manager`, allowing you to install Wine, graphics drivers, or DX wrappers externally.
- Added the ability to reinstall system files, allowing recovery even if the system files are accidentally damaged.
- Added more VKD3D feature level options.
- Added android `file provider` feature, allowing access to the Winlator data directory through the file manager.
- Added the ability to add `shortcuts` to the home screen, allowing you to launch your programs directly from the desktop. Shortcut changes will be synced in real-time.

#### Fixed
- Fixed the crash issue that occurred when running programs with long Japanese or Chinese titles.
- Corrected the button styling in the DXVK configuration dialog.
- Fixed certain abnormal issues on some SoCs (such as 870), by compiling Box64 with the `BAD_SIGNAL` parameter enabled.
- Fixed an issue that caused Steam to crash by removing the patch for `iphalpapi` in Wine.
- Fixed the font configuration, you can now add custom fonts to `imagefs/usr/share/fonts`.

#### Changed
- Set DXVK parameters via environment variables instead of configuration files, allowing for custom DXVK configuration files.
- Hide the system pointer when using an external mouse. Thanks to **xoureldeen** for the method.
- Removed the built-in `DXVK-0.96`, `DXVK-1.10.3`, and `Box64-0.3.1-dev`. These components will now be provided through add-ons.
- Update Wine to 9.15.
  
**Note**
- **.wcp** is the file extension for add-ons. It is compressed using XZ or Zstd and includes a `profile.json` file as a manifest. You can create your own add-on files containing various contents. Since these files often include executable programs, **make sure** to verify that add-ons from other sources do not contain malicious software before installation.
- **.rcp** is the file extension for custom Box64 configuration files. It uses a JSON data structure and can be used to generate a box64rc file that Box64 can read. #### Added
- Added `dxvk-2.4` and `dxvk-gplasync-2.4`, and set dxvk-2.3.1 as the default dxvk. 
- Added version switching and configuration support for `vkd3d`.
- Added `vkd3d-2.13`.
- Added an older version of `box64` (`box64-2.8`).
- Added support for linear triggers. (currently only for Xinput)

#### Fixed
- Fixed the path for the dxvk configuration file.
- Fixed the path for the Virgl server; `VirGL` is now working.
- Fixed keyboard input issues for some games.

#### Changed
- The `AVX` extension for box64 is **disabled** by default. It needs to be manually enabled by creating a new `box64 preset` in the settings.
- Enabled all cores by default for experimental wow64.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator/compare/v7.1.0...v7.1.1

**Note**: Please uninstall previous versions before installation to avoid potential errors. Remember to **back up** your data.

* Fix child account seeing all family games by @jeremybernstein in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/788

## New Contributors

* @FrancescoDesogus made their first contribution in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2102
